data.gender_notes: Mycah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mycah is recorded in name-lists as “God is my help”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mycah expresses “God is my help”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mycah total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מיכה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיכה הוא שם אישי עברי המשמר שלטון, ריבונות, שליטה, ושומר. הוא מופיע בספר שמואל א' 17:25 כשם של אחד מבני ישי.

in_greek.name: Μιχά
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Μιχά εἶναι ἕνα ἄτομον ὄνομα ἐκ τοῦ Ἑβραϊκοῦ, τοῦ ὁποίου ἐτυμολογία ἀναφέρεται στὴν ἀρχιερατεία, τὴν ἀρχή, καὶ τὴν ἐξουσία.

in_latin.name: Mycah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mycah de linguam Hebraeam originem habet, cuius significatio est regnum, potestas, et auctoritas. Nomen hoc in Scriptura Sacra in 1 Regum 17:25 apparit.
